verdict.rationale: Profiling and data-oriented scaling are fair questions for a game engine, but the evidence pack never mentions a profiler, hardware instancing, a job system, or a data-oriented ECS. The component references (rigidbody, collision, scripts on entities) describe a conventional entity-component model, which is an adjacent feature and not the data-oriented path the story asks for. An optimized math-library comment is likewise not evidence of profiling or scaling tools.
